scope: Audit-157 reader stops. Removing a native implementation does not discharge an included portable interface. No dummy foreign definitions, host addresses or host constant reads are supplied.

resolved.disposition: Native FFI composite-pointer mutation excluded with its definition. Not a linear-memory copy service.
Native malloc/macptr/finalizer allocation excluded with its definition. Not the portable heap allocator.

unresolved.disposition: Included numeric operation; needs additional pinned musl entries, condition handling and two-ULP qualification. The accepted transcendental export list ends at tanh.
Included virtual-namespace current directory; needs owner binding and UTF-8 buffer semantics, not the Node process cwd.
Included Lisp scheduler yield; requires the scheduler protocol, not a native process call or no-op.
Included interruptible sleep; requires owner timer and suspension support. No blocking browser main-thread wait.
Included application shutdown; requires owner request, flush and sibling-Worker policy.
Included abnormal shutdown; same owner protocol with failed-cleanup handling.
Native signal-resend path is excluded, but its quit-hook and owner-exit replacement remain unresolved.
Included fatal startup error; route through owner fatal boundary without removing ordinary Lisp error handling.
Included help/version completion; needs owner stdio and exit protocol, not Worker-only process.exit.
